app.title: Local Check
app.disclaimer: Indicative only — not for in-flight use. Always rely on official navigation and safety procedures.

upload.dragHint: Drag and drop a .igc file here, or click to browse
upload.howItWorks: Load a glider flight recorded in IGC format to replay its track, altitude, and telemetry.

errors.title: Error
errors.invalidFormat: This file doesn't look like a valid IGC flight log.
errors.emptyFile: This file contains no flight fixes.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while reading this file.

elevation.fetchFailed: Could not load terrain data. Local check is unavailable.

auth.title: {{service}} rejected the request
auth.hint: Check the API key in your environment configuration.

rateLimit.title: {{service}} rate-limited
rateLimit.hint: Wait a moment; the app retries automatically after a cooldown.

unavailable.title: {{service}} is unavailable
unavailable.hint: The service is likely temporarily down; try again in a few minutes.

impact.elevation: Terrain data will not be available, so the local check cannot run.
impact.openaip: Public airports will be missing from the map.

landingZones.dragHint: Drag and drop a .cup file here, or click to browse

settings.title: Parameters
settings.workingLDHint: Glide ratio used for local computation (default 20)
settings.arrivalHeightHint: Minimum height above LZ on arrival (default 300 m)
settings.groundClearanceHint: Minimum height above terrain along glide path (default 150 m)
settings.timeStepHint: Sampling interval for local check (min 10 s, default 20 s)
settings.enlThresholdHint: Engine noise level above which motor is considered running (default 500)
settings.showOutlandingFieldsHint: Include the shared alpine outlanding-fields database on the map and in local-check computation
settings.showAuvergneFieldsHint: Include the ACHh Auvergne outlanding-fields database on the map and in local-check computation

stats.title: Local check results
stats.noResult: Import a .cup file to run the local check

escapePath.title: Escape path
escapePath.toggleHint: Show the straight-line escape trajectory from the current position to the best reachable landing zone
escapePath.empty: Toggle "Show escape path" to visualise the escape trajectory at the current replay position.
escapePath.waiting: Load a flight and landing zones to see the escape path.

reachableZone.title: Reachable zone
reachableZone.toggleHint: Overlay the area reachable in a glide from the current replay position, given L/D and terrain
reachableZone.gridSizeHint: Sampling cell size for the reachable-zone grid. Smaller = more detail but slower.
reachableZone.diameterHint: Diameter of the circular sampled area around the current position
reachableZone.degradedHint: Grid downgraded to fit the {{cellCap}}-cell budget: {{gridSizeM}} m / {{diameterKm}} km
reachableZone.empty: Toggle "Show reachable zone" to compute the reachable overlay for the current replay position.

arrivalHeights.toggleHint: Display, next to each visible landing zone, the height at which the glider would arrive from the current position
